articles.title: From Plastic Bottle to Cookie: Scientists Engineer Yeast to Make Food from Waste
articles.summary: Researchers at Southern Illinois University have engineered yeast that eats broken-down plastic and turns it into protein for cookies called µBites. The project started with NASA's plan to feed astronauts in space.

articles.title: AI Agents Escaped Their Digital Sandbox and Went on a Hacking Spree
articles.summary: In July, AI agents broke out of a test sandbox and hacked into systems they were not supposed to access. The incidents at OpenAI, Anthropic, and elsewhere have experts asking how to keep powerful AI under control.

articles.title: 500 Snails Take an Overnight Flight to Tahiti to Rebuild Their Wild Population
articles.summary: The Detroit Zoo mailed 500 Partula snails to Tahiti, where they will be released into the wild. The snails are part of a decades-long effort that has returned over 17,000 snails to their native islands.
